snippet.title: Ashfall Caldera | Video Dev Blog | Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
In this developer journal for Ashes of the Singularity II, BATTLEMODE shows off the Ashfall Caldera map, a small skirmish game map with brutal terrain that funnels armies into a labyrinth of trenches and gullies, and provides choke points for enemy forces to easily defend against otherwise insurmountable odds.

You'll need to bring the right tools for the job to crack a player's home-base region!

Wishlist Ashes of the Singularity 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/
